summary: Restore strict owned audio WAVE oracles for retained source INFO and packet admission
before: Earlier broad owned_mp4_audio run has 4 failures (retained in batch-409 evidence). Fresh filtered baseline reproduces the two supposed resampling lookahead failures. An independent PCM/precision/geometry inspection proves all 3 authored container sources match WAVE sample payloads exactly: float32 704 bytes, float64 1408 bytes. Both Matroska files append exactly 24 bytes of LIST/INFO carrying default language eng; the old whole-WAVE oracle lacked that metadata.
after: All 8 owned_mp4_audio tests and the additional sample/metadata test pass (9 distinct checks), locked offline without default features. The two apparent DSP failures and source-WAVE parity failure were stale metadata oracles, while the planning test expected obsolete deferred packet admission. No media/DSP bug was fixed or counted.
tests_run: cargo test --locked --offline --no-default-features --test owned_audio_window_diagnostics -- --nocapture (temporary diagnostic path, then renamed)
limitations: This qualifies only the selected owned audio suite and sample/metadata contracts, not whole-project green.
No throughput or GPU/audio-device behavior claim.
uncounted: All test-oracle repairs and the extra positive-control regression
No production code or media algorithm changes
